items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: So, we brought, we got a daughter out there, of O'Reese. So, O'Reese gave me a job right away, at the Belgrade Cards.

ctx.x: You said, I think I forgot something. About to come later for us.

Anybody that came to New Orleans, there was any way of musicians, they came around, Lloyd Cannon, to see Joe. Joe was great. So, Mr. Cuadagnino brought Al down the door around there. So, I heard Al playing man, the riff is saxophone in the room. They had a piano room there. I almost played the piano. I knew it wasn't Joe. He was at the train theater. I said, who was that guy? So, I went to the window and I see Al, and I was at home playing the piano, a company, and I was playing stand-up playing saxophone. I was…
